  "memo":"R03 holds: the FR-issued card was used from a US IP with failed CVV. Card is the sole adverse family; no other rule holds, no household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Longstanding card use and an IP matching the account's home country support legitimate use with a CVV error, but do not establish who ordered. Recommend needs_check under §6.6(b), implemented as a hold with id_check. No check has run and the order is unshipped. Contact is not required. Decline is not permitted with only the Card family; a passed id_check requires clear."
